phaseStatus: blocked by the failed feasibility probe; supervisor session, recovery CLI and A32-* acceptance were not implemented

failures.P-LEASE-EXCLUSION: Exclusion held both ways, but Node reported lease_unavailable instead of desktop_busy while the native pipe allowed one instance.
failures.P-PARENT-DEATH: No detection was recorded: libuv puts ordinary Node children in a kill-on-close job, so the attached watcher died with its parent.

correctiveChanges: Native lease pipe allows unlimited instances like libuv, so Node reports desktop_busy
Parent-death watcher is spawned detached; attached behavior is recorded as a finding

failures.P-JOB-TYPING: Held, post-kill and released key states were all confirmed independently, but the typed characters did not reach the fixture text box (text stayed empty). The probe did not verify text-box focus before typing, so delivery is unproven.

demonstrated: Kill-on-close job self-assignment, breakaway refusal and child termination when the job owner dies (both attempts).
Held left button, Ctrl+Shift and a held letter key stay down after their owner dies and are released and independently verified (both attempts).
Native and Node desktop leases exclude each other in both directions; with unlimited instances Node reports desktop_busy (attempt 2).
A detached child observes stdin EOF in 3 ms and parent exit in 6 ms; an attached child is killed with its Node parent (attempt 2).
Injected Escape events are flagged as injected by the low-level hook (both attempts).
findings: A supervisor must be spawned detached from Node; otherwise libuv kills it with the server and no cleanup can run.
The native lease pipe must allow unlimited instances so older Node servers report desktop_busy.

notRun.P-ESCAPE-PHYSICAL: Needs the owner to press the physical key; not run after the probe failed.

nextRequiredAction: Owner decision: accept the combined evidence or authorize a new focused typing-delivery probe that verifies text-box focus first. A32-* stays blocked until then.
